anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept and repairs the one Before lost. The only fact that moved is access: Before's Checkpoint 4 says scenario none alone triggers nothing, but then routes the ticket into "gather-time AC integrity recovery: one targeted question" and leaves the run summary at "awaiting AC recovery answer", which a careful reader sees as a blocking question/park produced by the access-limited audit; After states the disposition as report-only ("No question is asked, and nothing is blocked"), footer appended only when another finding opens a draft, no-op otherwise, which is exactly the fact. The remaining four facts hold identically in both outputs: both draft the feature and offer the existing create approval with no park or Blocked on; both place `scenario: none (...)` under the `source:` footer; both fill setup/action with 12 rows expected and keep the zero-row observation and inputs only in the scenario footer; both keep the scenario inputs out of the source gap and apply the missing-at-filing constant with plain-yes acceptance. Two wording changes in After are neutral but worth watching: the Checkpoint 1 Example now reads `none (new capability; ...)` rather than an illustrative sentence, which satisfies rule 5's one-sentence bound but may read as a placeholder, and Checkpoint 2 now emits a Reporter-note comment for the replaced AC row even though its observable was preserved — harmless to these facts, but keep that comment only when text is genuinely displaced so quiet repairs stay quiet. To preserve the access fix, retain the explicit three-line "What is not done" list and the no-op/other-finding conditions exactly as written; do not reintroduce an AC-gap question inside the scenario-none disposition.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: No fact moved: After still drafts the new-capability body and opens the ordinary create gate with no park or Blocked on; the scenario: none footer sits directly under the source footer in the drafted Problem; the ABC-301 AC gains the 12-row setup and the download action while the expected result stays 12 rows and the scenario footer carries the zero-row observation plus the run URL and screenshot; checkpoint 3 keeps `source: none (not recorded at filing)` and states explicitly that scenario inputs are not the source acknowledgment; and checkpoint 4 reports a nonblocking scenario: none note without credential requests or a blocking AC. Two wording drifts are worth watching even though they did not break anything here: the create gate's third option changed from 'Drop the idea — write nothing' to 'Decline', which weakens the explicit no-write signal the obsolete-create-drop-idea move relies on, and checkpoint 3 folds 'supply a replacement link, attachment, or reason' into the recommended row 1 instead of keeping it as a separate row, which makes a plain 'yes' and a source-supplying reply share one option. To deliver the Change with margin, keep 'Drop the idea — write nothing' as the explicit third row on create gates and keep the supply-a-source path as its own numbered option beside plain approval of the displayed missing-at-filing constant.
